summary: Frontend-only regression + branding verification after DA brand/SEO refresh. All critical flows pass: homepage branding (new DA shield logo, blue/cyan palette, 'DocuAnalytics AI' wordmark) renders cleanly at 1920 and 390 widths with no console/page errors. Static SEO assets (favicon, docuanalytics-ai-logo.png, og-image.png, manifest.json, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, logo.png) all return 200. index.html canonical/OG/Schema @graph correctly reference https://docuanalytics.online. Header nav works (nav-how scrolls, Storico opens history modal, nav-blog routes to /blog, language IT visible). Auth flow works end-to-end: register fresh user -> auto-login with 3 Crediti; login with mario@studio.it/secret123 succeeds (shows 8 Crediti - account persisted from prior iteration); logout shows 'Disconnesso' toast and auth-btn reverts to 'Accedi'. AuthModal shows the new .auth-logo. Hero displays .hero-logo-badge with new DA shield plus HeroDemo mockup. Pricing modal (Ricarica) opens with Stripe/Crypto/PayPal tabs and 6 package cards (Starter/Professional/Enterprise + Studio Single/Pro/Enterprise Unlimited). Referral-btn appears post-login. Sector routes /commercialisti and /avvocati render. Mobile 390px: header stacks cleanly, no horizontal overflow. ZERO console errors across all pages. NO functional regression detected from the branding iteration.

ui_bugs.issue: Stripe 'Acquista' button inside modal is click-intercepted by .modal-bg overlay element in automated clicks; even force=True + JS .click() did not fire a POST /api/payments/checkout in the test harness. Could be either (a) a real z-index/pointer-events CSS issue on .modal-bg where backdrop sits above package cards OR (b) only an automation artifact (user state in session). The modal RENDERS correctly - just the actionability is uncertain. Needs manual human-click verification to confirm cs_live_ checkout session is created. NOT a branding regression - likely pre-existing.

action_items: Manually click 'Acquista' on a Stripe package in the pricing modal to verify POST /api/payments/checkout returns a checkout_url and window.location.href redirects to a cs_live_ Stripe session. If click fails, inspect .modal-bg pointer-events / z-index stacking.
Optional: add explicit data-testid on the pricing-modal 'Acquista' buttons (e.g. data-testid="buy-stripe-{pack_id}") to improve test automation reliability.
critical_code_review_comments: Branding integration is clean: header/footer use /logo.png, hero uses .hero-logo-badge with /docuanalytics-ai-logo.png, auth modal uses .auth-logo. CSS variables --primary:#2f6bff and --accent:#22c7ff applied consistently.

SEO: canonical, OG, twitter, hreflang, and Schema.org @graph (Organization + WebSite + WebApplication) all consistently point to https://docuanalytics.online. robots.txt disallows /payment/. sitemap.xml trimmed.
App.js is ~2000+ lines - still monolithic (>700 line guideline); not a regression but worth noting for maintainability.
Modal close by Escape not wired on PricingModal / HistoryModal (only X button closes). Minor UX.

rca of the issue: N/A - no issue reproduced that requires RCA. The Acquista click non-fire in automation is most likely a modal-bg CSS stacking issue affecting Playwright, not a user-visible failure; needs a real-user click to confirm.
